```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# ============================================================
# ORA analysis for top 100 mutated cancer genes vs all 949 mutated cancer genes
# Purpose: recurrence-enriched pathways
# Query/input:
#   Top 100 frequently mutated cancer genes
#
# Background/universe:
#   All nonsilently Oncovar mutated cancer genes (n=949) in the cohort
#
# Outputs:
#   1. Reactome ORA table + bubble plot
#   2. MSigDB Hallmark ORA table + bubble plot
#   3. GO Biological Process ORA table + bubble plot
# ============================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(enrichplot)
  library(msigdbr)
  library(ReactomePA)
})
```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Input files
# -------------------------------

top100_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/plots/Oncovar_gene/Tier1_common_cancerGeneList_top100_mutated_genes.tsv"

background_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/plots/Oncovar_gene/Tier1_common_cancerGeneList_mutation_frequency_all_genes.tsv"

# -------------------------------
# Output directory
# -------------------------------

out_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/plots/Oncovar_gene/ORA_top100_mutated_cancer_genes"

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -------------------------------
# Read top 100 query genes
# -------------------------------

top100_dt <- fread(top100_file)

if (!"Hugo_Symbol" %in% colnames(top100_dt)) {
  stop("Hugo_Symbol column not found in top100 file.")
}

top_genes <- unique(toupper(trimws(top100_dt$Hugo_Symbol)))
top_genes <- top_genes[!is.na(top_genes) & top_genes != ""]

message("Top genes used for ORA query: ", length(top_genes))

# -------------------------------
# Read background genes
# -------------------------------
# Background = all nonsilently mutated cancer genes in the cohort

background_dt <- fread(background_file)

if (!"Hugo_Symbol" %in% colnames(background_dt)) {
  stop("Hugo_Symbol column not found in background file.")
}

background_genes <- unique(toupper(trimws(background_dt$Hugo_Symbol)))
background_genes <- background_genes[!is.na(background_genes) & background_genes != ""]

message("Background genes used for ORA: ", length(background_genes))
```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Convert SYMBOL to ENTREZ ID
# -------------------------------

top_map <- bitr(
  top_genes,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
)

bg_map <- bitr(
  background_genes,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
)

top_entrez <- unique(top_map$ENTREZID)
bg_entrez <- unique(bg_map$ENTREZID)

message("Top genes mapped to Entrez: ", length(top_entrez))
message("Background genes mapped to Entrez: ", length(bg_entrez))

if (length(top_entrez) < 5) {
  stop("Too few top genes mapped to Entrez IDs.")
}

if (length(bg_entrez) < length(top_entrez)) {
  stop("Background Entrez gene set is smaller than query set.")
}
```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Helper function:
# -------------------------------

save_ora_result <- function(
  enrich_obj,
  out_prefix,
  title_text,
  table_file,
  show_n = 20
) {
  
  enrich_dt <- as.data.table(enrich_obj)
  
  fwrite(
    enrich_dt,
    file.path(out_dir, table_file),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )
  
  message(out_prefix, " significant terms: ", nrow(enrich_dt))
  
  if (nrow(enrich_dt) == 0) {
    message("No significant terms found for ", out_prefix, ". Plot skipped.")
    return(invisible(enrich_dt))
  }
  
  pdf_file <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0(out_prefix, "_bubbleplot.pdf")
  )
  
  png_file <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0(out_prefix, "_bubbleplot.png")
  )
  
  p <- dotplot(
    enrich_obj,
    showCategory = show_n,
    title = title_text
  ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    labs(
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Background: all nonsilently mutated cancer genes, n = ",
        length(background_genes)
      )
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = pdf_file,
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 8
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = png_file,
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  message("Saved bubble plot:")
  message(pdf_file)
  message(png_file)
  
  invisible(enrich_dt)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Reactome pathway ORA
# ============================================================

reactome_ora <- enrichPathway(
  gene = top_entrez,
  universe = bg_entrez,
  organism = "human",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff = 0.25,
  readable = TRUE
)

reactome_dt <- save_ora_result(
  enrich_obj = reactome_ora,
  out_prefix = "Reactome_ORA_top100_vs_all_mutated_cancer_genes",
  title_text = "Reactome enrichment: top 100 mutated cancer genes",
  table_file = "Reactome_ORA_top100_vs_all_mutated_cancer_genes.tsv",
  show_n = 20
)

```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# MSigDB Hallmark ORA
# ============================================================

# msigdbr changed argument names across versions.
# This block supports both older and newer versions.

msigdbr_args <- names(formals(msigdbr::msigdbr))

if ("collection" %in% msigdbr_args) {
  hallmark <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
    species = "Homo sapiens",
    collection = "H"
  )
} else {
  hallmark <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
    species = "Homo sapiens",
    category = "H"
  )
}

hallmark_term2gene <- as.data.table(
  hallmark[, c("gs_name", "gene_symbol")]
)

hallmark_term2gene[, gene_symbol := toupper(trimws(gene_symbol))]

hallmark_ora <- enricher(
  gene = top_genes,
  universe = background_genes,
  TERM2GENE = hallmark_term2gene,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff = 0.25
)

hallmark_dt <- save_ora_result(
  enrich_obj = hallmark_ora,
  out_prefix = "MSigDB_Hallmark_ORA_top100_vs_all_mutated_cancer_genes",
  title_text = "MSigDB Hallmark enrichment: top 100 mutated cancer genes",
  table_file = "MSigDB_Hallmark_ORA_top100_vs_all_mutated_cancer_genes.tsv",
  show_n = 20
)
```

  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.25,

)
